title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta16

## Prioritized loading and selective multi-mower rendering

### Faster first useful view

- Request the lightweight base map without waiting for the backend `current_cycle_render`, then fetch the compact current-cycle artifact during an idle/background phase.
- Keep compatibility with earlier Navimower versions: integrations that still return the artifact with the base payload continue to work without a second request.
- In Multi mower mode, load member maps first with bounded concurrency and render each completed member incrementally. Session indexes and selected-day render archives no longer block the first combined map.

### Multi-mower update efficiency

- Prioritize active mowers, then the anchor mower, before idle members.
- Limit member-map, session-index and history-render request concurrency to two instead of starting every request at once.
- Separate structural map changes from live mower pose changes. Position/heading-only updates now replace only the affected mower marker instead of rebuilding every zone, trail, overlay, dock and legend element.
- Add render fingerprints for per-mower controls and session rows so unrelated Home Assistant state updates do not rewrite unchanged UI.
- Preserve one public `navimower-map-card.js` runtime file.

### History reliability

- Remove the hidden eight-session-per-mower day limit. Every retained session for the selected Home Assistant calendar day remains available.
- Resolve selected-day membership in the Home Assistant time zone rather than assuming the browser time zone.
- Replace permanent `null` session-render caching with a bounded LRU cache and a 30-second retry window for temporary failures.
- Make asynchronous History selection last-request-wins and discard late results after mower/card identity changes.

### Request and lifecycle safety

- Add generation checks to Site, member-map, session-index, current-cycle and selected-session responses.
- Invalidate pending selections and deferred responses when the card disconnects or its configured mower changes.
- Keep current-cycle, History and Settings data non-blocking while primary mower state, controls and map geometry remain immediately useful.

### Build simplification

- Stop replaying the complete historical `upgrade-*` chain on every release candidate.
- Prepare the cumulative runtime with only version synchronization, the current beta16 pipeline upgrade and the deterministic single-file build.
- Retain the full existing regression suite and add a permanent beta16 contract covering load order, concurrency, retry behavior, stale-response rejection, complete History days and selective live updates.

### Compatibility

- Recommended companion integration: Navimower 0.4.4-beta28 or newer for the phased `include_current_cycle=0` / `current_cycle_only=1` API.
- Older supported integrations remain usable because the Map API default response contract is unchanged.
